title: Applying deep learning to iterative screening of medium-sized molecules for protein-protein interaction-targeted drug discovery.
summary: Iterative screening identified active compounds outside public chemical space, with inhibition-assay validation; this supports biochemical hits, not clinical efficacy.
ai_technology: Deep neural network trained on first-round inhibition assays
organization: Keio University; Axcelead Drug Discovery Partners Inc. (Japan); RIKEN

evidence.tested: Iterative screening identified active compounds outside public chemical space, with inhibition-assay validation; this supports biochemical hits, not clinical efficacy.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Deep neural network trained on first-round inhibition assays is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
